title: Work IQ: Context IQ adds agents, skills and content sources to the prompt menu
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap dates, existing Context IQ behaviour, agent controls and neighbouring billing rules are supported. It distinguishes those existing capabilities from the planned expansion and leaves the expansion's default, licensing and control applicability explicitly unconfirmed.

claims.where: What's changing; summary; changes; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the expansion's specific agent, skill and source choices.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Context IQ" "agents" "skills" "570854"' and 'Context IQ expanded agents skills content sources Work IQ menu default licensing admin controls'; opened Work IQ overview and the cited Context IQ support article. No expansion-specific description found.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: The expansion's default state and rollout activation mechanics are unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: '"ExpandedContextIQ" licensing default rollout' and 'Context IQ expanded agents skills content sources Work IQ menu default licensing admin controls'; read the roadmap, Work IQ overview and Context IQ support article. No expansion default stated.

claims.where: front matter: licensing; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a licensing model specific to the expanded Context IQ selection experience.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Context IQ" "agents" "billing"' and '"ExpandedContextIQ" licensing default rollout'; opened Work IQ overview and Purchase and manage agents in Copilot Chat. Existing agent billing is documented, but no expansion-specific licensing model was found.

claims.claim: No tenant-wide UI setting or automation call is documented for the new Context IQ agent, skill and source choices.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Context IQ" "admin" "Graph" "settings"' and 'Context IQ expanded agents skills content sources Work IQ menu default licensing admin controls'; opened agent management, registry, Work IQ overview and Business Applications default settings. No such switch found.

claims.quote: Searched: registry page text for GET, preview, AI Admin and Block; read its Microsoft Graph API section and example. It documents GET packages and GET package details, not a block call.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Manage agents page says organisation members can only access agents the administrator has allowed.
claims.quote: Members of your organization can only access the agents that you have allowed.

claims.claim: The Block action is an organisation-wide agent access control.
claims.quote: **Block and unblock** | Restrict access to an agent across the organization, preventing any user from using it.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specifically confirmed how agent allow and block decisions determine the expanded Context IQ menu.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Context IQ" "admin" "Graph" "settings"' and '"Context IQ" "agents" "skills" "570854"'; read Manage agents, agent-actions and the Context IQ support article. General agent access controls are documented, but expanded-menu behaviour is not.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: Only files are available to reference when Work IQ is off.
claims.quote: Only files are available to reference when you've turned off **Work IQ** in chat.

claims.claim: Only files are available to reference for users without a Microsoft Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Only files are available to reference for users without a Microsoft Copilot license.

claims.claim: The support article's Work IQ button is a user control at the top right of the chat page.
claims.quote: At the top right of the chat page, turn off the **Work IQ** button.

claims.claim: The Work IQ overview says its actions run in a user's context and access only what that user may see or do.
claims.quote: Actions are user scoped, meaning every request runs in the context of a specific user and only accesses what that user is allowed to see or do.

claims.claim: The Work IQ overview does not state that its action-scoping description covers the expanded Context IQ menu.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Context IQ" "skills" "identity" "actions"'; opened Work IQ overview and read Security, authorization, and governance. Its user-scoped action description does not mention Context IQ.

claims.claim: The Work IQ overview says every tool invocation is logged and evaluated.
claims.quote: Every tool invocation is logged and evaluated, enabling auditability, usage analytics, rate limiting, and real-time compliance enforcement across agents and data sources.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented whether a Context IQ agent or skill selection follows that Work IQ invocation path.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Context IQ" "skills" "identity" "actions"' and '"Context IQ" "agents" "skills" "570854"'; opened Work IQ overview and Context IQ support. Neither describes invocation routing for the expanded menu.

claims.claim: The identity used by an agent selected through the expanded Context IQ menu is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Context IQ" "skills" "identity" "actions"'; read Work IQ overview, Manage agents and Context IQ support. No passage identifies the runtime identity for an agent selected through the planned menu.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether selecting an agent or skill through the new menu enables read-only grounding or actions.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Context IQ" "skills" "identity" "actions"'; opened Work IQ overview and Context IQ support. General Work IQ action capabilities are described, but no passage defines the action capabilities of the planned selection experience.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Work IQ API usage consumes Copilot Credits shared with other eligible services.
claims.quote: Work IQ API usage consumes Copilot Credits shared with other eligible services.

claims.claim: For Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users, Work IQ is available across Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences and agents.
claims.quote: For Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users, Work IQ is available in all Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences and agents.

claims.claim: The Work IQ overview qualifies that availability with usage-based billing for custom and third-party agents.
claims.quote: It is subject to usage-based billing for custom and third-party agents.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate price or meter is published for the new Context IQ menu interaction itself.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Context IQ" "agents" "billing"'; opened Work IQ overview and Purchase and manage agents in Copilot Chat. Read the Business Applications costs search excerpt. These describe API or consuming-experience charges, not a separate Context IQ selection charge.

claims.claim: Agents accessing shared tenant data are metered for Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 (Basic) licences.
claims.quote: For Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 (Basic) licenses, agents that access shared tenant data, such as SharePoint or Graph Connector content, are billed based on metered consumption.

claims.claim: Declarative agents grounded in instructions and public websites are included under the cited Copilot licensing rules.
claims.quote: Declarative agents that are grounded in instructions and public websites are included with Copilot Chat (Basic), and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic) and (Premium).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether the expanded menu's choices follow the existing licence and Work IQ-button split.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Context IQ" "Work IQ" "files" "license"' and '"Context IQ" "agents" "skills" "570854"'; read Context IQ support and Work IQ overview. Existing reference eligibility is described, but eligibility for the expansion is not.

claims.claim: Business Applications data in Work IQ available to Copilot is a Microsoft 365 admin center tenant setting governing Power Apps and Dynamics 365 data use in Copilot Chat.
claims.quote:
Use the tenant-level setting to manage whether Power Apps and Dynamics 365 data can be used in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat across the tenant.
In **Copilot settings**, select **View all** > **Business Applications data in Work IQ available to Copilot**.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed whether the Business Applications tenant setting governs the expanded Context IQ choices.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Context IQ" "admin" "Graph" "settings"'; opened Business Applications in Work IQ default settings, Work IQ overview and Context IQ support. The business-data control is documented, but its relationship to the planned menu choices is not.
